note: Every number here is an assumption, not a measurement. totals.py takes measured rates from the raw results and these assumptions, and shows the totals at half and double the people-time assumptions. Change a number here, never in code.

labor_usd_per_hour.source: lifecycle/arms/prices.json (labor): round figures for a fully loaded front-desk clerk hour and automation engineer hour

operator_s.source: lifecycle/cost_model.py V1 (lifecycle-cost/2026-10-20.1); no real operator timings exist yet
operator_s.manual_entry_mockmed_why: a MockMed triage note is one click path and one note field, about a third of the 12-field OpenEMR registration the cost model's 180 s is for

per_outcome.note: What a person does after each outcome. One interrupt per item that reaches a person.
per_outcome.silent_wrong_why: lower bound: someone later finds the wrong record, fixes it and enters the item again (two interruptions: when found and when fixed). Clinical or business harm is not priced.

setup_people_min.note: One-time people time per workflow, by role. The agent's own authoring time and model cost are measured and reported separately.

openadapt.why: cost model V1: teach preparation 5 min + a 2 min demonstration + compile review 10 min + admission 5 min; plus an engineer's 30 min to install it and write the record check (verify.yaml), the same read-back work the agent arms' engineer does

openadapt_regulated_openemr.why: as above, plus an engineer's 30 min for the Regulated deployment (keys, sealed bundle, durable store, problems-only switch); the qualification campaign runs unattended

agent_tools.why: an engineer wires a browser-tools agent (an off-the-shelf framework gives read_screen/click/fill), writes the record read-back tool and the check rule into the prompt, and tries it

agent_script.why: an engineer prompts the coding agent with the demonstration and the API description, reads and tests the script it submits

cua_alone.why: an engineer writes the task prompt and deploys the computer-use loop

maintenance_people_min.note: People time per maintenance event, by kind.
maintenance_people_min.script_fix_review_why: an engineer reads the coding agent's diff and its dry run, and deploys it
maintenance_people_min.script_fix_by_hand_why: lifecycle/arms/prices.json engineer_script_fix_s (30 min), when the coding agent's own fix did not hold
maintenance_people_min.openadapt_reteach_why: a change OpenAdapt neither handled nor self-repaired: the person teaches the workflow again (same as setup)
maintenance_people_min.agent_prompt_fix_why: a change an agent kept failing on: an engineer adjusts the prompt

detection.note: Silent wrongs are charged one cleanup each; how long they go unnoticed is not modelled.

volume.why: lifecycle/arms/prices.json drift rate: about one vendor release every few weeks at a clinic's referral volume
volume.server_faults_why: assumed: one save in 100 goes wrong on the server side. The MockMed suite has 5 in 100 to measure detection; the excess cost per fault item is measured there and applied at this rate.
